scope: Pre-execution lifecycle counter clarification only; no new cases or semantic/CLI outcome changes

source_derivation.reason: Load failure returns before checker invocation. A checker error returns before the common check/run/compile consumer dispatch.

The executable project checker attempts route computation once, selects its route, enters index construction and returns the frozen index before owned resolution/type/check_typed. Any intervening ? exits without retry; ownership rejection prevents successful checked-executable return.

check_typed lowers, associates and verifies ownership before successfully returning its source program. The accepted E0310 ownership outcome therefore has route/index completions but no checked-program completion.

before.source_lifecycle_applicability: Each source file that completes loading, lexing and parsing; unsuccessful earlier stages require case-specific partial counts

successful_frontend.applicability: Source loading and complete front-end checking successfully return a checked program

source_or_parse_rejection.applicability: Source loading or parsing rejects before complete checker invocation

before.other_semantic_rejection: Case-specific stage observations; no universal complete-checker/route/index count is inferred

after.source_lifecycle_applicability: Each source file that completes loading, lexing and parsing; unsuccessful earlier stages require case-specific partial counts

successful_frontend.applicability: Source loading and complete front-end checking successfully return a checked program; later missing-entry or native-admission rejection retains these counts

source_or_parse_rejection.applicability: Source, lex, parse or host load rejection before complete checker invocation

route_computation_rejection.applicability: Route computation rejects before selecting a route or entering index construction

index_construction_rejection.applicability: Index construction rejects after route selection and before returning the frozen index

body_type_ownership_rejection.applicability: Body, type or ownership checking rejects after successful frozen-index construction and before a checked executable returns

other_semantic_rejection.other_failures: Use source-derived reached-phase counts: one attempt for each entered phase, zero for unreached phases, and a completion only when that phase returns its specified result; no universal semantic-rejection completion count

counter_definitions.checker_attempts: Invocation of the one selected complete source checker after successful load
counter_definitions.checked_program_completions: Successful return of its checked executable program, before check/run/compile consumer admission
counter_definitions.route_attempts: Entry into the selected checker's whole-program scalar/owned route computation
counter_definitions.route_completions: Successful selection of that one route
counter_definitions.index_attempts: Entry into the selected path's one declaration-index construction pipeline
counter_definitions.index_completions: Successful return of the frozen declaration index, before downstream body/type/ownership/consumer work

counter_semantics.attempt: Entry into the phase, including an eventual error
counter_semantics.completion: Successful return of the phase's specified result
counter_semantics.exactly_once: Each reached phase is entered exactly once; an unreached phase has zero attempts; no retries, repeated attempts or second traversal are allowed
counter_semantics.completion_bound: Each successful-completion count is at most its corresponding attempt count
counter_semantics.case_expected_lifecycle_applicability: A case-level expected_lifecycle applies separately to every declared observation or operation, in each existing profile and host scope
counter_semantics.cli_status: Do not infer phase completion from command exit status

corrections.reason: Define all six measurement boundaries, replace ambiguous old counter names, and preserve conditional reached-phase counts for existing coverage
